cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
성기사 협회가 브릴까지
정화 원정 왔대!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle comic shot on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal grassy ground touch. On the left, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Troll Shaman points eagerly toward a small rocky hill on the right while cute 2.5-head chibi SD Undead Paladin watches calmly with her one-handed mace and golden shield held at her side. On the right hill, a group of cute 2.5-head chibi SD Alliance paladin extras in golden plate armor pitch warm beige-brown medieval quilted wool sleeping bags with leather straps beneath a tiny crusade banner.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
나도 정식 성기사인데
다굴 심판이 어딨어.
cuts.visual_prompt: Slightly low-angle wide shot on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal cobblestone ground touch. On the left, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Undead Paladin sits dizzy on the ground with little comic stars spinning over her head and her golden shield resting against her knee. On the right, a smug cluster of cute 2.5-head chibi SD Alliance paladin extras in golden armor point accusingly at her while raising tiny golden hammers in celebration.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
감히 언더시티 코앞에서
정화 완료를 외쳐?
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder medium shot from behind on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone path touch. On the right beside a small Horde stone gatepost, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Orc Warrior with a one-handed axe and Horde shield leans forward with a fierce grin next to cute 2.5-head chibi SD Undead Paladin pointing down the road. On the left, a tidy line of cute 2.5-head chibi SD Alliance paladin extras marches cheerfully toward them waving golden banners.

Extreme close-up bust shot filling 80 percent of the frame height on a pure #FFFFFF background. Cute 2.5-head chibi SD Undead Paladin stares deadpan straight ahead with cold half-lidded eyes and a faint chilling smirk, translucent golden Consecration runes glowing subtly around her shoulders. Behind her shoulders, silhouettes of cute 2.5-head chibi SD Horde soldiers surge forward in a dramatic silent freeze-frame.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic side-angle action shot on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal ground dust puffs. Charging from left to right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Undead Paladin raises her golden shield and one-handed mace alongside cute 2.5-head chibi SD Orc Warrior swinging a one-handed axe with her Horde shield. On the right, shocked cute 2.5-head chibi SD Alliance paladin extras fly cartoonishly into the air like bowling pins amid comic impact clouds.

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
결국 본인들이 제일 먼저
정화당하고 무덤 갔네.
cuts.visual_prompt: Wide side-angle aftermath shot on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal grassy ground touch. On the right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Troll Shaman and cute 2.5-head chibi SD Undead Paladin sit casually next to abandoned warm beige-brown medieval quilted wool sleeping bags with leather straps and dropped golden helmets. Toward the left, tiny translucent blue-white cute 2.5-head chibi SD paladin spirits jog away together in shame.
